gloss: order of numbers; numerical order; in number order

definitions.gloss: order of numbers; numerical order; in number order
definitions.explanation: The arrangement of items, people, or documents according to their assigned number, typically ascending. Used for calling patients at clinics, processing applications, seating students, and organizing files.

examples.japanese: {番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}に{並|なら}ぶ。
{受付|うけつけ}{番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}にお{呼|よ}びします。
examples.english: We will call you in order of your reception number.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}を{番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}に{並|なら}べてファイルに{綴|と}じた。
examples.english: I arranged the documents in number order and put them into a file.

examples.japanese: {出席|しゅっせき}{番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}に{答|こた}えてもらいますので、{前|まえ}の{人|ひと}の{答|こた}えもよく{聞|き}いてください。
examples.english: I'll have you answer in order of attendance number, so please listen carefully to the previous person's answer as well.

notes:
Formed from {番号|ばんごう} (number) + {順|じゅん} (order, sequence). A highly practical everyday word used wherever numbered tickets, IDs, or slots are involved.

USAGE:
- Frequently heard at hospitals, banks, city offices, and restaurants where numbered tickets or reservations are used.
- Commonly appears with {並|なら}ぶ (to line up), {呼|よ}ぶ (to call), {並|なら}べる (to arrange), and {処理|しょり}する (to process).
- In Japanese schools, students are often assigned an {出席|しゅっせき}{番号|ばんごう} (attendance number), and teachers may call on them in {番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}に{並|なら}ぶ: to line up in number order
- {番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}にお{呼|よ}びする: to call (people) in number order
- {番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}に{処理|しょり}する: to process in number order
- {出席|しゅっせき}{番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}: in order of attendance number
- {受付|うけつけ}{番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}: in order of reception number

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {五十音|ごじゅうおん}{順|じゅん}: Japanese syllabary order — the traditional way of sorting Japanese names and words
- アルファベット{順|じゅん}: alphabetical order
- {到着|とうちゃく}{順|じゅん}: order of arrival
- {受付|うけつけ}{順|じゅん}: order of reception (first come, first served)
- {年齢|ねんれい}{順|じゅん}: order by age
